payout_quote: Offer only valid for new Orion Financial members opening new Orion Financial Free Checking accounts. Offer not available to individuals who currently have, or have had within 90 days of opening the new account, a deposit or loan product of any kind with Orion Financial. Offer also not available to individuals who have had any deposit account closed with a negative balance within three (3) years of opening the new account. You can receive only one new checking account opening related bonus per person and per account. The amount of your bonus is considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT or Form 1042-S to the IRS. Eligibility may be limited based on account ownership. Offer is non-transferrable and non-assignable. Offer availability is subject to change with or without notice. Offer valid for accounts opened from 09/1/2026 through 10/31/2026. To receive the bonus: Open an Orion Financial Free Checking account on or before 10/31/2026, which is subject to approval; and establish a direct deposit made to this account within 90 days. Your direct deposit must be an electronic deposit of your paycheck, pension, or government benefits (such as Social Security) from your employer or the government. Micro-deposits do not qualify as direct deposits for bonus eligibility. Aside from opening the account, all requirements to receive the bonus must be met by 1/29/2027. Orion Financial will deposit the bonus into your account within 120 days of account opening if all requirements are met. To receive the bonus, the enrolled account must not be closed or restricted at the time of payout.
